name: Red Leather Bandanas
summary: Red Leather Bandanas is a bounty task issued by Scout Galiaan at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. As the Peoples Militia struggles to track the Defias Brotherhood across the plains, Galiaan offers a reward to anyone willing to thin their numbers and bring back the distinctive red cloth masks worn by the outlaws.

sections.title: A Mark of Allegiance
sections.body: Across Westfall, the red bandana has become the unmistakable calling card of the Defias Brotherhood. While the gang employs common cutpurses, looters, and traitors from all walks of life, they bind their ranks together under this crimson standard. For Scout Galiaan and the beleaguered People's Militia at Sentinel Hill, collecting these trophies serves two purposes: confirming the elimination of bandits and gathering intelligence on their shifting fronts across the countryside.

sections.title: The Militia's Scouting Efforts
sections.body: With Stormwind denying Westfall proper military reinforcement, the People's Militia relies heavily on seasoned observers like Scout Galiaan to chart Defias activities. Galiaan spends his days monitoring outlaw patrols from the safety of Sentinel Hill, relying on passing adventurers and militia volunteers to do the bloody work of cutting down the highwaymen who have driven honest farmers from their soil.

faq.q: Why do the Defias wear red leather bandanas?
faq.answer: The red leather bandana serves as the unified uniform and symbol of allegiance for the Defias Brotherhood. It disguises the identities of former laborers, thieves, and outlaws while striking terror into the remaining farmers of Westfall.

Scout Galiaan is a member of the People's Militia stationed at Sentinel Hill. He monitors the movements and shifting fronts of the Defias Brotherhood across Westfall, coordinating bounty tasks for adventurers to curb outlaw activity.

faq.q: Why does the Militia need adventurers to collect these bandanas?
faq.answer: The People's Militia is stretched desperately thin, operating without royal soldiers or funding from Stormwind. By offering bounties for proof of slain bandits, scouts like Galiaan can chip away at the Defias forces without leaving the defense of Sentinel Hill undermanned.

faq.q: Where are the bandits carrying these bandanas found?
faq.answer: Defias outlaws roam virtually every corner of Westfall, occupying abandoned farmsteads, prowling the crossroads, and camping along the Gold Coast and around the Moonbrook hills.

faq.q: What happens to the bandanas after you turn them in?
aliases: what does galiaan do with bandanas
faq.answer: Scout Galiaan uses them as proof of fallen outlaws to track their shifting fronts and gauge how severely the militia's campaigns are affecting the Brotherhood's numbers in the region.

faq.q: Is the Stormwind Army involved in this bounty?
faq.answer: No. The Stormwind military has largely abandoned Westfall to focus on other internal troubles, leaving local defense entirely in the hands of Gryan Stoutmantle and the volunteer People's Militia.

angles.text: Taking bounties for the People's Militia directly supports Westfall's local defense when Stormwind's royal leadership fails to send aid.
The crimson masks worn by Defias highwaymen are a grim reminder of how skilled rogues and cutpurses have organized into an army on Stormwind's doorstep.
